limitationNamedHonestly.v1SessionGatedRouteNotDirectlyExercised: The v1 /api/esri/one-click-at-point route requires a real staff OIDC session (server/replit_integrations/auth/replitAuth.ts) that this lane does not hold credentials for, and creating or bypassing one was out of scope and not attempted. Verification instead relies on: (1) the route's own source code being byte-for-byte identical in its query construction to platformOneClickAtPoint aside from variable names (both read the same BASTROP_LAYER_REGISTRY['parcels-one-click'] object, confirmed by direct code comparison), and (2) platformOneClickAtPoint itself being verified live, both broken and fixed, through two independently-routed v2 endpoints. This is reported as a proxy verification, not claimed as a direct UI test of the v1 screen.
